method: Each vertex (every 5th) of the Z-Anatomy mesh is assigned to the nearest BodyParts3D 4.0 part after registration (bp3d_frame.json + pelvic ICP in bp3d_icp.json). Shares are fractions of sampled vertices; far_gt_1cm = fraction farther than 1 cm from every listed part.
note: BodyParts3D 4.0 has no separate sigmoid colon mesh.

decisions.Sigmoid colon -> Rectum: Geometry is the BodyParts3D rectum and spans S3 to below the pelvic diaphragm.
decisions.Jejunum -> Jejunum and ileum: Mesh covers both source parts; not split because 16% of vertices are over 1 cm from either.
decisions.Descending colon -> Descending and sigmo: Lower end turns medially to the midline below the pelvic brim.
decisions.Caecum not added: 60% of the BodyParts3D caecum vertices fall inside the Z-Anatomy small-intestine mesh.
decisions.External anal sphincter added: Pelvic ICP median 1.1 mm; overlap with rectum 9.5% vs 22% inside the source itself.
